notes: Story levels 1 to 5 playtest fixes: a second fuel crate to find north of the reactor in Level 1, a better pod layout in Level 2, a clearer order of lines and arrows in Levels 3 to 5.
Guide arrows no longer point at a pod that is already gone, circle a pod once before you tow it, and send you to the ore first when the reactor is low and your hands are empty.
Sela now walks straight up to the kiosk in Level 3 instead of lurching the last few steps.
